title: Congress and League adopt the Lucknow scheme
detail: At their Lucknow sessions, Congress adopted the joint reform scheme on 29 December and the Muslim League on 31 December. The scheme accepted separate electorates and stated Muslim representation in Bengal at 40 percent of elected Indian council members.

title: Government of India Act, 1919: regulations lower Bengal Muslim seats
detail: The Pakistan Historical Society history says regulations under the Government of India Act, 1919, reduced Muslim representation in Bengal to 30 percent.
